Who we are

Enterprise technology built around real operations.

Hamerkop Systems is an Ethiopian enterprise technology company headquartered in Addis Ababa. We work with institutions that need reliable systems, stronger control and a clear connection between technology and day-to-day operations.

Enterprise scope

ERP, electronic invoicing, financial technology, identity, integration and data form the core of Hamerkop's technology work.

Connected architecture

Finance, invoicing, payments, identity, operational systems and data are connected around defined workflows and shared information.

Ethiopian operating context

Projects are shaped around local business, regulatory and institutional realities while maintaining enterprise technology standards.

Lifecycle ownership

Hamerkop works from discovery and implementation through go-live, stabilization, support and continuous improvement.

Hamerkop EIMS

Electronic invoicing that stays connected to the business behind it.

Electronic invoicing works best when it follows the same transaction, finance and reporting flow already used by the organization.

A connected invoicing workflow

Electronic invoicing affects more than the document sent to a customer. It touches transaction data, finance, reporting, approval, validation and the systems where the original sale or service is recorded.

EIMS keeps those processes connected so invoicing does not become another isolated application inside the institution.

How we deliver

From operational problem to stable system.

A four-stage path takes the work from operating requirement to live, supported system.

Discover. Design. Implement. Stabilize and improve.

01

Discover

Map the current operation and requirements.

02

Design

Define the system, integrations and controls.

03

Implement

Configure, connect, migrate and prepare users.

04

Stabilize & Improve

Support go-live and improve the live environment.

Security & governance

Control belongs inside the system.

Security and governance are part of how institutional systems are structured, accessed, connected and operated.

Access & accountability

Roles, permissions and traceable activity create clearer responsibility around critical workflows.

Integration & data control

Defined interfaces and data structures reduce uncontrolled movement between systems and teams.

Continuity & regulatory alignment

Operational support and applicable reporting requirements are considered as part of the deployed environment.
